newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia starts mass voucher privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Croatia starts mass voucher privatisation.

text.p: Croatia kicked off a mass voucher privatisation programme on Monday by beginning to register all people eligible to take part, the Vecernji List daily reported.
Each beneficiary has to register with the Croatian Privatisation Fund to be entitled to up to 7,000 privatisation points which can later be exchanged for stakes in some 800 companies.
At least half of the beneficiaries are victims of the 1991-95 war in former Yugoslavia including displaced people and war invalids, the daily said.

Some 400,000 people are expected to register by the end of September. Then they will either buy stakes in companies re-starting business in territory recaptured from Serbs in 1995, or compete for other shares in three bidding rounds. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
